_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. a reference swatch sheet for a private late-career comic page: samples of a spare knowing ink line with generous white, soft watercolor swatches of muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, a luminous sunbreak wash, a figure drawn from behind in three strokes, a reflection in rain-streaked glass, and the word ROFLCOPTER lettered tiny in a margin; labeled ERA IV 2021–2027. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
